name: Gracewell LeadForge
author: gracewell89

sections.description:
Gracewell LeadForge helps you capture more leads with beautiful, professional popups that don’t annoy your visitors.

Key Features

  • Easy Setup – Install, activate, and start capturing leads in minutes
  • Customizable Fields – Show/hide Name, Phone, and Message fields
  • Smart Triggers – Time delay trigger to show popup at the right moment
  • Cookie Suppression – Don’t annoy visitors – remembers when they close the popup
  • Email Notifications – Get notified instantly when you capture a new lead
  • Lead Management – View, manage, and export all your leads
  • CSV Export – Download your leads for use in other tools
  • Mobile Responsive – Looks great on all devices
  • Professional Design – Clean, modern interface that converts
  • Customizable Colors – Match your brand perfectly

Perfect For

  • Small businesses collecting customer inquiries
  • Bloggers building email lists
  • Service providers generating leads
  • E-commerce stores capturing potential customers
  • Anyone looking to grow their email list

Free Version Features

  • Single popup
  • Email capture (required field)
  • Optional Name, Phone, Message fields
  • Time delay trigger
  • Cookie suppression
  • Lead database
  • CSV export
  • Email notifications
  • Color customization
  • Mobile responsive

Pro Version – Now Available

Upgrade to LeadForge Pro at gracewell.in/gracewell-leadforge

  • Exit intent trigger – Show popup when visitor is about to leave
  • Scroll percentage trigger – Show popup after visitor scrolls X% down the page
  • Page targeting – Show popup on specific pages only, or exclude specific pages
  • Mobile device toggle – Disable popup on mobile devices
  • Annual licence, domain-locked – $19/year single site

LeadForge Premium (Coming Soon)

  • Everything in Pro
  • Mailchimp + ConvertKit integration
  • A/B testing
  • Advanced analytics
  • Custom CSS
  • 3-site licence

Privacy Policy

Gracewell LeadForge stores lead information (name, email, phone, message, page URL, IP address) in your WordPress database. This data is only accessible to site administrators and is never shared with third parties.

This plugin sends anonymous usage data (site domain, plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version) to gracewell.in to help improve the plugin. No personal data, email addresses, or lead information is ever transmitted. This occurs on activation, deactivation, and weekly thereafter.

Support

For support, please visit gracewell.in or use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gracewell-leadforge folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Gracewell LeadForge → Settings to customize your popup
  4. Enable the popup and you’re done!
sections.faq:
How do I customize the popup?

Go to Gracewell LeadForge → Settings in your WordPress admin. You can customize the headline, colors, fields, timing, and more.

Can I export my leads?

Yes! Go to Gracewell LeadForge → Leads and click the “Export to CSV” button to download all your leads.

Will this slow down my website?

No. Gracewell LeadForge is lightweight and optimized for performance. The popup only loads after your page content is ready.

Can I change the popup colors?

Yes! You can customize all colors in the Settings page to match your brand.

Does it work on mobile?

Absolutely! The popup is fully responsive and looks great on all devices.

How do I disable the popup temporarily?

Go to Gracewell LeadForge → Settings and uncheck “Enable Popup”. Save settings.

Where are leads stored?

Leads are stored securely in your WordPress database and are only accessible to site administrators.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes! LeadForge Pro adds exit intent trigger, scroll percentage trigger, page targeting, and mobile toggle. Available at gracewell.in/gracewell-leadforge/ for $19/year.

What data does the plugin collect for its own use?

To help improve the plugin, LeadForge sends anonymous usage data to gracewell.in — your site domain, plugin version, WordPress version, and PHP version only. No personal data, emails, or lead information is ever transmitted.
